title: Cardiology Department
description: Cardiology is the study and treatment of heart conditions. Our consultants provide diagnosis, prevention, imaging, and ongoing management for cardiac patients.

FAQ.question: When should I see a cardiologist?
FAQ.answer: Chest pain, breathlessness, palpitations, fainting, high blood pressure, or strong family history should be reviewed.

FAQ.question: Do you provide preventive care?
FAQ.answer: Yes. We offer screening, lifestyle planning, and medication review for patients at increased cardiac risk.

seo.title: Cardiology Department | Medicoz
seo.description: Cardiology care, cardiac risk assessment, and preventive heart health services at Medicoz.

title: Neurology Department
description: Neurology focuses on disorders of the brain, spine, nerves, and muscles with careful examination and focused imaging pathways.

FAQ.question: What happens during a neurology visit?
FAQ.answer: The doctor reviews symptoms, performs a neurological examination, and recommends tests or treatment based on the pattern.

FAQ.question: Do I need imaging?
FAQ.answer: Imaging depends on symptoms, exam findings, and clinical risk. Your neurologist will recommend it only when useful.

seo.title: Neurology Department | Medicoz
seo.description: Neurology diagnosis and treatment planning for brain, spine, nerve, and muscle conditions.

title: Urology Department
description: Urology provides focused care for urinary and reproductive health concerns using modern diagnostics and minimally invasive planning.

FAQ.question: Can I book directly?
FAQ.answer: Yes. You can book a urology review directly or after referral from a primary physician.

FAQ.question: Are procedures outpatient?
FAQ.answer: Many diagnostic and minor procedures are outpatient, while complex cases receive a dedicated plan.

seo.title: Urology Department | Medicoz
seo.description: Urology consultations, diagnostics, and procedure planning at Medicoz Medical Solution.

title: Gynecological

FAQ.question: Do you offer routine screenings?
FAQ.answer: Yes. We offer preventive reviews, screening referrals, and follow-up for women's health needs.

FAQ.question: Can I request a female doctor?
FAQ.answer: Our scheduling team will help match patients with available specialists whenever possible.

title: Pediatrical

FAQ.question: Do you treat newborns?
FAQ.answer: Yes. We provide newborn reviews, feeding guidance, and referral coordination when specialist care is needed.

FAQ.question: Can parents stay during the visit?
FAQ.answer: Yes. Family-centered visits keep parents involved and children more comfortable.

title: Laboratory

FAQ.question: Do I need fasting?
FAQ.answer: Some tests require fasting. The booking team will confirm preparation instructions before your appointment.

FAQ.question: How are results shared?
FAQ.answer: Results are shared securely and reviewed with your clinician when interpretation is needed.
